title: Provider adapter SPI
summary: Six provider operations are separated: identity, broad capabilities, scoped discovery, dispatch, inbound verification and reconciliation. The reference adapter is simulation-only.
invariants: Adapter registration is not publication authority.
Inbound authenticity verification and remote delivery verification have different evidence and must remain separate.
Use existing API Client, Secret Broker, Identity, policy, queue and journal authorities.
